units.source_text: 名人身旁放着一个椭圆形的梧桐木大火盆。

en.t: Beside the Master stood a large oval brazier made of paulownia wood.

units.source_text: 为了防止感冒，身后还放了一个长方形的火盆，开水冒出了热气。

en.t: To keep him from catching cold, a rectangular brazier had also been placed behind him, and steam rose from the boiling water.

units.source_text: 七段说了一声“请便”，名人就顺从他的话围上了围巾，

en.t: When the seventh-dan player said, “Please go ahead,” the Master obediently wrapped a scarf around his neck,

units.source_text: 里面穿着毛衣，外面裹上外褂似的御寒服。

en.t: wearing a sweater underneath and wrapping himself on the outside in a haori-like winter garment.
I heard that he had a slight fever.
